statement: Labour share (nonfarm business, 4-quarter average) in 2027 is >= 1 pp below 2025 (BLS Productivity & Costs, Q4 2027 release)
status_at_phase_end: 2025 is the baseline year itself. As of end-2025 only Q1-Q2 2025 data had been published: Q1 showed unit labour costs (+6.9%) outrunning unit nonlabour payments (-0.3%), i.e. labour share up; Q2 showed nonlabour payments slightly ahead (+2.0% vs +1.6%). The Q3 release (scheduled 6 Nov) was delayed to Jan 2026 by the 43-day federal shutdown, so no 2025 4-quarter average was computable in-phase. No AI-driven fall in labour share was visible in 2025 data published in 2025.

items.summary: Revised Q4 2024 release: 2024 nonfarm-business productivity +2.8%; Q4 unit labour costs +3.8% vs unit nonlabour payments -0.5% (annualised), pointing to a slight rise in labour share at end-2024.
items.detail: BLS Productivity and Costs, Q4 2024 revised (2025-03-06); quarterly figures as later shown in the 2025-08-07 release Table 2 (Bloc A). Exact Q4-2024 revision values taken from the later table, so may differ slightly from the March vintage.

items.summary: Revised Q1 2025 release: nonfarm-business productivity fell ~1.5-1.8% (annualised); unit labour costs rose ~6.6-6.9% while unit nonlabour payments fell - labour share rose in Q1 2025.
items.detail: BLS Productivity and Costs Q1 2025 revised (2025-06-05). Values per revised figures shown in the 2025-08-07 vintage (productivity -1.8%, ULC +6.9%, nonlabour -0.3%).

items.summary: Preliminary Q2 2025 release: nonfarm-business productivity +2.4%, unit labour costs +1.6% vs unit nonlabour payments +2.0% (annualised) - labour share roughly flat to slightly down. Year-on-year ULC +2.6% vs nonlabour +1.4%.
items.detail: BLS Productivity and Costs, Second Quarter 2025, Preliminary (2025-08-07), Table 2 (verified). Indexes 2017=100: ULC 123.6, nonlabour 130.2, price deflator 126.5.

items.summary: Revised Q2 2025 release: nonfarm-business productivity revised up to +3.3% (annualised), implying a smaller unit-labour-cost rise and a slight fall in labour share in Q2.
items.detail: BLS Productivity and Costs, Second Quarter 2025, Revised (2025-09-04).

items.summary: The Q3 2025 preliminary release scheduled for 6 Nov 2025 (and the 9 Dec revision) did not appear because of a federal funding lapse; Q3 data were first published 8 Jan 2026. The 2025 baseline could not be computed within the phase.
items.detail: BLS release schedule (Q3 2025 initial 2025-11-06, revision 2025-12-09); shutdown note in the delayed release. 43-day Bloc A government shutdown, Oct-Nov 2025.

items.summary: No comparable quarterly labour-share series exists for Bloc B; the indicator relies on a single-jurisdiction source.
items.detail: Same known gap as the 2026 phase: BLS covers the Bloc A only; Bloc B NBS publishes no quarterly labour-share equivalent.
